# File System (fs)

> Part of the [Implementation Status](README.md) index. Node-`fs`-shaped synchronous file I/O for reading/writing config, data, and logs — not `File`/`FileReader`/`FileSystemFileHandle` (those model browser sandbox/permission concepts that don't exist for a native CLI/microservice program with direct filesystem access).

**Coverage**: 19/21 (~90%) · **Strict Coverage**: 11/21 (~52%).

Format: [Status page format](README.md#status-page-format).

| Feature | Status | Caveats | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fs.readFileSync(path[, options])` | ✅ | | • Node's `lib/fs.js` in TypeScript over one native request per operation (open, fstat, read, close — `lib/node/internal_fs.ts`, `threadpoolsrc/klainfs.c`) ([ADR-01298](../adr/ADR-01298.md))<br>• With no encoding a `Buffer` of the file's exact bytes; with one (a string or `{ encoding, flag }`, any Buffer encoding, a variable included) the bytes decoded, embedded null bytes kept<br>• A file descriptor in place of the path reads it to its end (`readFileSync(0)` is stdin); a file whose stat size is 0 (`/proc`, `/sys`) is read to EOF<br>• Errors are Node's: `ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '<path>'`, `EISDIR: illegal operation on a directory, read`, with `code`/`errno`/`syscall`/`path` |
| `fs.writeFileSync` / `fs.appendFileSync` | ✅ | | • `data` a string (any encoding) or any `ArrayBufferView`; a path or a descriptor; `{ encoding, mode, flag, flush }` ([ADR-01298](../adr/ADR-01298.md))<br>• `mode` applies when the file is created (umask-reduced); `flush` fsyncs before closing; any other `data` is Node's `ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE` |
| `fs.existsSync(path)` / `fs.accessSync(path[, mode])` | ✅ | | • `existsSync` never throws; an argument of another type is `false` with Node's DEP0187 warning. `accessSync`'s mode is validated to 0–7 as Node's is ([ADR-01298](../adr/ADR-01298.md)) |
| `fs.statSync` / `lstatSync` / `fstatSync` → `Stats` | ✅ | • `{ bigint: true }` (`BigIntStats`) is not implemented: the option is ignored | • Node's `Stats`: the 14 numeric fields as own properties, `atime`/`mtime`/`ctime`/`birthtime` Date getters on the prototype, and the kind predicates; `throwIfNoEntry: false` returns `undefined` for `ENOENT`/`ENOTDIR` ([ADR-01298](../adr/ADR-01298.md))<br>• On Linux the stat is `statx`, as libuv's, so `birthtimeMs` is the file system's birth time (the ctime where it has none) |
| `fs.statfsSync(path)` → `StatFs` | ✅ | • `{ bigint: true }` is ignored: the fields are numbers | • `{ type, bsize, frsize, blocks, bfree, bavail, files, ffree }`: `statfs(2)` on POSIX; on Windows `GetDiskFreeSpaceW` of the path's volume with `type`/`files`/`ffree` 0, as in Node ([ADR-01078](../adr/ADR-01078.md)) |
| `fs.mkdirSync` / `mkdtempSync` / `rmdirSync` / `rmSync` / `unlinkSync` | ✅ | • `rmSync`'s `maxRetries`/`retryDelay` are validated and unused (Node retries `EBUSY`/`ENOTEMPTY`/`EPERM`) | • `mkdirSync` takes a mode or `{ recursive, mode }`; a recursive one returns the first directory it made. `rmSync` removes a tree with `{ recursive }`, a missing path quietly with `{ force }`, and a directory without `recursive` is Node's `ERR_FS_EISDIR` `SystemError`; `rmdirSync`'s `recursive` works with Node's DEP0147 warning ([ADR-01298](../adr/ADR-01298.md))<br>• A directory given to `unlinkSync` throws as Node does per host (`EISDIR` on Linux, `EPERM` on macOS/Windows) |

| `File` / `FileReader` / `FileSystemFileHandle` (browser-flavored File API) | ❌ | | **Differentiator (scoped — [TDD-00172](../tdd/TDD-00172.md)).** Splits in two: the **data layer** (`File extends Blob`, `FileReader.readAsText`/`ArrayBuffer`/`DataURL`) is a thin fs-backed reinterpretation with no UI — path-backed `File`s, reads firing `onload` on the event loop; the **picker layer** (`showOpenFilePicker` → `FileSystemFileHandle`) resolves a path through a pluggable UI backend — a `klain:tui` file-picker widget, a `klain:webview` native dialog, or an explicit-path degradation when headless. Serves interactive native apps (TUI file managers/editors); the data layer is the near-term, standalone-useful piece. |
